name: Engine Packs and Assistant Observation
purpose: Validate provider-neutral runtime compilation, external assistant observation, sessions, and proposed-write review without turning Studio into an AI client.

product_language.boundary: Prompting belongs to the assistant. Project stewardship belongs to Loom Studio.

acceptance.requirement: Studio requires no provider login, API key, or embedded prompting surface to use assistant observation.
Versioned engine-pack contract supports detect, install, inspect, compile, upgrade, and remove operations.
Generic filesystem pack installs assistant-neutral instructions and runtime configuration without changing author documents.
acceptance.method: Install into temporary fixture and compare canonical document hashes.

acceptance.requirement: Claude Code pack installs conventions and optional hooks without requiring Anthropic API credentials.
Compile project graph into deterministic guide, cast, manuscript, and project runtime capsules under .loom/runtime.
Generated runtime files are replaceable artifacts and never become canonical project truth.
acceptance.method: Delete and regenerate runtime directory; verify canonical files unchanged.

acceptance.requirement: Capability-based adapter contract normalizes sessions, activity, proposals, and connection state.
Generic filesystem adapter observes external JSONL session events without controlling the prompting process.
acceptance.method: Write fixture events externally and verify normalized activity feed.

acceptance.requirement: Session metadata and activity history persist under .loom/sessions and reopen after Studio restart.
acceptance.method: Automated persistence test and manual restart flow.

acceptance.requirement: Studio shows live normalized status, reads, writes, tasks, waits, completions, and errors when supplied by an adapter.
acceptance.method: Synthetic event stream and manual UI review.

acceptance.requirement: External tools can create proposal bundles under .loom/proposals without touching canonical files.
Author can preview, accept, reject, or edit a proposal; acceptance uses safe writes and may create a bookmark.
acceptance.method: Automated proposal lifecycle plus manual review UI.

acceptance.requirement: Stale proposals detect changed base documents and require explicit conflict handling.
acceptance.method: Change canonical file after proposal creation and validate stale status.

acceptance.requirement: Assistant activity is a secondary, collapsible desk within the writer-first binder rather than the main application surface.
All Milestone 1 authoring, archive, timeline, graph, and project lifecycle tests remain green.
